scope: Every allowlisted file plus every object reachable in the embedded public fixed-source bundle
method: Full omission of original second-MCP provider response
Omission of account-authentication log row and request/authorization drafts
Credential, key, credential-URL and platform-identifier patterns
Manual review of retained report, refusal logs and source provenance
history_requirement: New branch must have exactly clean public base plus one evidence commit; isolated push-object audit recorded after commit
limitations: Bounded review of the specified evidence set; no claim about arbitrary external sources or unexamined data.
